heading: Reports to Congress: submission in electronic form

tree.heading: Requirement.—
tree.text: Whenever the Secretary of Defense or any other official of the Department of Defense submits to Congress (or any committee of either House of Congress) a report that the Secretary (or other official) is required by law to submit, the Secretary (or other official) shall provide to Congress (or such committee) a copy of the report in an electronic medium.

tree.heading: Exception.—
tree.text: Subsection (a) does not apply to a report submitted in classified form.

tree.heading: Definition.—
tree.text: In this section, the term “report” includes any certification, notification, or other communication in writing.

notes.text: Amendments2002—Subsec. (a). Pub. L. 107–314 substituted “shall provide to Congress (or” for “shall, upon request by any committee of Congress to which the report is submitted or referred, provide to Congress (or each”.
